title: Oldest GUI application that still runs on Windows 11
summary:
The article explores the oldest GUI application capable of running natively on Windows 11. Initial investigation, noting Windows 11's lack of NTVDM for 16-bit programs, focused on early NT-era applications.

The author first successfully ran FREECELL.EXE, dated February 22, 1993, from an early Win32s release, natively on Windows 11. This application was an impressive 33 years and 8 months old.

Seeking older software, the author examined Windows NT 3.1 pre-release versions. Challenges included incompatible draft PE formats from 1991 and incorrect CDECL calling conventions in builds up to mid-1992. However, CDPLAYER.EXE from NT 3.1 Build 347, linked November 16, 1992, was found to work. It circumvented C runtime issues by using the system's `crtdll.dll` (still present in Windows 11) and adhered to the correct stdcall calling convention. Though it initially required a `cdemu.dll` to emulate a CD-ROM drive for full functionality, this application is nearly 34 years old.

Lastly, the article touched upon "cheating" by using emulators. With `otvdm`, a 16-bit application, REVERSI.EXE, dated November 15, 1985, from Windows 1.01, was made fully playable on Windows 11, demonstrating even older software with emulation.
chinese_title: 仍在 Windows 11 上运行的最古老的图形界面应用
chinese_summary:
本文探讨了能在Windows 11上原生运行的最古老的GUI应用程序。最初的调查注意到Windows 11缺少用于16位程序的NTVDM，因此将重点放在了早期NT时代的应用程序上。

作者首先成功地在Windows 11上原生运行了来自早期Win32s版本、日期为1993年2月22日的FREECELL.EXE。这款应用程序令人惊叹地已有33年零8个月的历史。

为寻找更早的软件，作者检查了Windows NT 3.1的预发布版本。挑战包括1991年不兼容的PE格式草案以及截至1992年中期构建版本中错误的CDECL调用约定。然而，发现来自NT 3.1 Build 347、链接日期为1992年11月16日的CDPLAYER.EXE可以运行。它通过使用系统中的`crtdll.dll`（在Windows 11中仍然存在）规避了C运行时问题，并遵循了正确的stdcall调用约定。尽管它最初需要`cdemu.dll`来模拟CD-ROM驱动器以实现完整功能，但这款应用程序已有近34年的历史。

最后，文章提到了使用模拟器进行“作弊”的方法。借助`otvdm`，一款来自Windows 1.01、日期为1985年11月15日的16位应用程序REVERSI.EXE得以在Windows 11上完全可玩，这展示了通过模拟器运行更旧软件的可能性。

title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
summary:
Moderna and Merck have announced that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, intismeran (mRNA-4157), in combination with Merck's Keytruda, significantly reduced the risk of death or recurrence in melanoma patients. A late-stage (Phase 3) trial, involving 1,137 patients with surgically removed stage IIB–IV melanoma, showed a 42% reduction in the risk of recurrence or death compared to Keytruda alone.

After two years, 82% of patients receiving the intismeran-Keytruda combination were alive without recurrence, versus 70% in the Keytruda-placebo group. Furthermore, the combination treatment reduced the risk of distant metastasis or death by 38%, with 88.5% of the combination group alive without distant metastasis compared to 80% in the control group.

The personalized vaccine uses synthetic mRNA to target up to 34 unique mutations found in a patient's own cancer cells, aiming to help the immune system selectively attack these cells. This breakthrough, though slightly less impactful than results from an earlier Phase 2 trial, marks a significant advance in melanoma treatment. The companies are now seeking regulatory approval, reinforcing optimism for individualized mRNA-based cancer therapies. The full data is accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine.
chinese_title: 莫德纳和默沙东称，其mRNA癌症疫苗将死亡和复发率降低42%。
chinese_summary:
Moderna和默沙东宣布，他们的个性化mRNA癌症疫苗intismeran (mRNA-4157)与默沙东的Keytruda联合使用，显著降低了黑色素瘤患者的死亡或复发风险。一项涉及1137名已通过手术切除IIB-IV期黑色素瘤患者的后期（III期）试验显示，与单独使用Keytruda相比，该联合疗法使复发或死亡风险降低了42%。

两年后，接受intismeran-Keytruda联合治疗的患者中有82%存活且未复发，而Keytruda-安慰剂组的这一比例为70%。此外，联合治疗将远处转移或死亡的风险降低了38%，联合治疗组有88.5%的患者存活且未发生远处转移，而对照组为80%。

这种个性化疫苗利用合成mRNA靶向患者癌细胞中多达34种独特的突变，旨在帮助免疫系统选择性地攻击这些细胞。尽管这一突破的效果略低于早期II期试验的结果，但它标志着黑色素瘤治疗的重大进展。两家公司目前正在寻求监管批准，这进一步增强了人们对个体化mRNA癌症疗法的乐观情绪。完整数据已被《新英格兰医学杂志》接受发表。

title: ChatGPT Keeps Telling People 404 Media Can Solve Their Tech Support Problems
summary:
Users encountering routine tech support problems, especially account bans and data loss, are increasingly turning to ChatGPT due to the lack of human customer service from major tech platforms. The article reveals a concerning trend: ChatGPT is frequently misdirecting these users to 404 Media, suggesting their issues are journalistically significant and even composing the outreach emails.

The author cites an example of a Russian man whose Instagram account was banned, leading to the loss of 13 years of memories. ChatGPT advised him to email "Jason at 404 Media," provided the contact information, and drafted the exact email he sent, implying his situation warranted journalistic investigation due to 404 Media's focus on technology-related inquiries.

404 Media has observed a surge in such AI-generated emails over the past two weeks. Upon questioning senders, they consistently learn that an AI chatbot recommended contacting them, often writing the entire message. This situation highlights the critical void in accessible customer support from big tech, forcing users to rely on AI tools that are, in turn, incorrectly steering them towards investigative journalists for what are essentially technical assistance issues.

title: Removing Next.js Got My Blog to 100 on Every Lighthouse Category
summary:
The author set out to build a lightweight, fast, accessible blog aiming for a perfect 100 Lighthouse score, finding existing platforms like Medium, WordPress, and Ghost unsatisfactory due to bloat or complexity. Initially, he built his blog using Next.js.

Despite implementing robust caching (ISR, `fetch` options) and image optimization (Cloudflare Image Transformations), the Next.js blog achieved high scores in the 90s but not the desired 100. The core issue was identified as Next.js's framework runtime, which shipped "legacy JavaScript," runtime chunks, and hydration code even for static pages composed solely of server components. Crucially, components like `next/link` and `next/image` inherently pulled in client-side code, leading to a significant 230KB of unused JavaScript.

Realizing this overhead was counterproductive for a static site, the author decided to abandon Next.js. He migrated to Hono, drawn by its "fast and simple" philosophy and JSX support. This switch proved transformative: the blog finally achieved a perfect 100 across all Lighthouse categories. Unused JavaScript plummeted to just 407 bytes, build time decreased by 40%, and the "long task before render" improved by 78% (from 309.3ms to 68.01ms).

The author concludes that while Next.js is excellent for interaction-heavy applications (which he uses for his blog's management app), its inherent JavaScript payload and hydration are often unnecessary for static sites, hindering optimal performance. He showcases his resulting blogging platform, Bloffy, at bloffy.co.
chinese_title: 移除 Next.js 让我的博客 Lighthouse 全面 100 分
chinese_summary:
作者旨在构建一个轻量、快速、易用的博客，目标是Lighthouse得分达到完美的100分，他发现现有平台如Medium、WordPress和Ghost因其臃肿或复杂性而无法令人满意。最初，他使用Next.js构建了他的博客。

尽管实施了强大的缓存策略（如ISR、`fetch`选项）和图片优化（Cloudflare图片转换），这个Next.js博客仍取得了90多分的高分，但未能达到预期的100分。核心问题被确定为Next.js的框架运行时，它即使对于仅由服务器组件组成的静态页面，也会附带“遗留JavaScript”、运行时块和水合代码。更重要的是，像`next/link`和`next/image`这样的组件本身就会引入客户端代码，导致产生了多达230KB的未使用JavaScript。

意识到对于一个静态站点而言，这种开销适得其反，作者决定放弃Next.js。他转向了Hono，因为它“快速而简单”的理念和对JSX的支持吸引了他。这一转变带来了巨大成效：博客最终在所有Lighthouse类别中都达到了完美的100分。未使用的JavaScript骤降至仅407字节，构建时间减少了40%，“渲染前的长任务”改善了78%（从309.3毫秒降至68.01毫秒）。

作者总结道，尽管Next.js非常适合交互密集型应用（他将其用于博客的管理应用），但其固有的JavaScript负载和水合机制对于静态站点而言通常是不必要的，阻碍了最佳性能。他在bloffy.co展示了他的成果——博客平台Bloffy。

title: The EPA Is Quietly Killing Its Web Archive
summary:
The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is moving to decommission its comprehensive online web archive by December 31, 2026, a decision that would eliminate tens of thousands of publicly available environmental resources. This move, quietly announced, marks a renewed effort after a similar attempt in 2022 by the Biden administration was met with significant public backlash, leading to delays.

The archive is an "irreplaceable" historical repository, housing documents like fact sheets, environmental reports, and policy changes dating back to the 1990s. It serves as a vital tool for researchers, legislators, and the public for "democratic oversight," tracking major environmental policies (e.g., Bush's Clear Skies, Obama's Clean Power Plan), and crucially preserved climate change information deleted during the Trump administration. It also aided environmental enforcement, such as the investigation into contamination at Camp Lejeune.

Critics, including Gretchen Gehrke of the Environmental Data and Governance Initiative (EDGI), warn that losing this information will create a "tremendous gap" in the historical record. Lauren Harper of the Freedom of the Press Foundation argues it will erode public trust, force researchers to file burdensome FOIA requests for once-public data, and undermine government transparency.

Though the EPA previously cited $2 million in annual upkeep costs, there's skepticism that proposed "snapshot collections" can adequately replace the comprehensive archive. The EPA did not respond to requests for comment.
chinese_title: 美国环保署悄然关闭其网络档案
chinese_summary:
美国环境保护署（EPA）正在着手停用其全面的在线网络档案，截止日期为2026年12月31日。这一决定将删除数万份公开可用的环境资源。此举是悄然宣布的，标志着又一次尝试，此前拜登政府在2022年也曾尝试过类似做法，但因遭到公众强烈反对而导致延期。

该档案是一个“不可替代的”历史资料库，收藏了自1990年代以来的事实情况说明书、环境报告和政策变化等文件。它为研究人员、立法者和公众提供了进行“民主监督”的重要工具，用于跟踪主要的环保政策（例如布什的“清澈天空计划”、奥巴马的“清洁电力计划”），并且至关重要的是，保存了特朗普政府期间被删除的气候变化信息。它还协助了环境执法，例如对勒琼营地污染的调查。

包括环境数据和治理倡议组织（EDGI）的格雷琴·格尔克在内的批评人士警告称，丢失这些信息将在历史记录中造成“巨大空白”。新闻自由基金会的劳伦·哈珀则认为，此举将侵蚀公众信任，迫使研究人员对曾经公开的数据提出繁琐的《信息自由法》（FOIA）请求，并损害政府透明度。

尽管EPA此前曾以每年200万美元的维护费用为由，但人们普遍怀疑其提议的“快照集合”能否充分取代这一全面的档案。EPA没有回应置评请求。

title: Attention Is Not What You Need (2025)
summary:
The paper "Attention Is Not What You Need" challenges the necessity of explicit self-attention in sequence modeling, describing standard multi-head attention as an opaque "tensor lifting" mechanism. As an alternative, the authors propose an attention-free architecture built on Causal Grassmann layers.

This novel design processes information by (i) linearly reducing token states, (ii) encoding local token pairs as two-dimensional subspaces on a Grassmann manifold using Plucker coordinates, and (iii) fusing these geometric features via gated mixing. Unlike Transformers, where computation occurs in an unstructured tensor space, the Grassmann model's core operations reside on a finite-dimensional manifold, propagating information through controlled deformations of low-rank subspaces over multi-scale local windows. This architecture offers linear scaling in sequence length for a fixed rank.

Experimental results demonstrate its efficacy: on the Wikitext-2 language modeling benchmark, purely Grassmann-based models (13-18 million parameters) achieve validation perplexities within 10-15% of size-matched Transformers. Furthermore, on the SNLI natural language inference task, a Grassmann-Plucker head on top of DistilBERT slightly outperforms a Transformer head, achieving validation and test accuracies of 0.8550 and 0.8538, respectively, compared to 0.8545 and 0.8511. The authors suggest that such manifold-based designs provide a more structured route toward interpretable neural reasoning.
chinese_title: 注意力不是你需要的 (2025)
chinese_summary:
论文《Attention Is Not What You Need》对序列建模中显式自注意力的必要性提出了质疑，将标准多头注意力描述为一种不透明的“张量提升”机制。作为替代方案，作者们提出了一种基于因果格拉斯曼层（Causal Grassmann layers）的无注意力架构。

这种新颖的设计通过以下方式处理信息：(i) 线性地降低token状态，(ii) 使用普吕克坐标（Plucker coordinates）将局部token对编码为格拉斯曼流形（Grassmann manifold）上的二维子空间，以及 (iii) 通过门控混合（gated mixing）融合这些几何特征。与计算发生在非结构化张量空间中的Transformer不同，格拉斯曼模型的核心操作驻留在有限维流形上，通过多尺度局部窗口上低秩子空间的受控形变来传播信息。对于固定秩，这种架构在序列长度上提供了线性伸缩性。

实验结果证明了其有效性：在Wikitext-2语言建模基准测试中，纯格拉斯曼模型（13-18百万参数）实现的验证困惑度在与大小匹配的Transformer模型的10-15%范围内。此外，在SNLI自然语言推理任务中，DistilBERT之上的格拉斯曼-普吕克头部略优于Transformer头部，分别达到了0.8550和0.8538的验证和测试准确率，而Transformer头部则为0.8545和0.8511。作者们认为，这种基于流形的设计为可解释的神经推理提供了一条更结构化的路径。
